machines.name: Timestretch
machines.description: Tempo-locked loops with cached pitch-preserving stretch and drum-pad controls.

machines.name: Ring Mod
machines.description: Ring modulation from slow pulses to metallic tones, with a sine-to-square carrier.

machines.name: Karplus
machines.description: A plucked string: a pick excites a tuned delay line that rings and fades.

machines.name: Hurdy Gurdy
machines.description: A bowed-string hurdy gurdy: rosined wheel, drones that carry across notes, and a buzzing bridge you stroke in time.

machines.name: Wane
machines.description: Analogue-style pads heard through one worn, shared tape: detuned morphing oscillators that drift, with wow, flutter, sag and age.

machines.name: Bloom
machines.description: Breathing additive pads: 24 sine partials shaped by tilt, shape, stretch and a sung vowel, drifting, beating in detuned pairs and blurring into breath.

machines.name: Hollow
machines.description: A resonator choir: breath and a soft bow through tuned bodies (vox, string, pipe, glass) whose held notes ring sympathetically into each other.

machines.name: Orbit
machines.description: A vector synth: four vintage digital waves at a diamond's corners, mixed by a point that orbits a centre, through an old DAC's grit.

machines.name: Bend
machines.description: Phase distortion after the Casio CZ: two lines read a cosine through bent phase maps, from sine to saw, pulse and resonant sweeps.

machines.name: Moth
machines.description: A west-coast complex oscillator: an FM'd sine through a wavefolder into a vactrol lowpass gate that pings, holds and glows.

machines.name: Sand
machines.description: A bowed plate covered in sand: grains rattle on its moving areas, then settle into the figure's nodal lines, leaving a glassy tone.

machines.name: Cocoa
machines.description: The hot chocolate effect: each note stirs bubbles into the drink and a spoon taps the mug, each tap ringing higher as the bubbles rise out.

machines.name: Coin
machines.description: Euler's disks spun on a mirror: each note's whirr rises along a finite-time power law through its ring, then stops dead.

machines.name: Fermi
machines.description: A Fermi-Pasta-Ulam-Tsingou chain per note: its modes' energies are the partials. Low energy is a pure tone, middle breathes and returns, high thermalizes.

machines.name: Mach
machines.description: Each note flies past you at a Mach number you choose. Below Mach 1 a Doppler glide; above it, silence, a boom, then the sound forwards and backwards at once.

machines.name: Butterfly
machines.description: A struck chain of sites in a magnetic field: its energies (Hofstadter's butterfly) ring as partials, in q clusters at flux p/q.

machines.name: Drop
machines.description: A drop on a hot skillet: past the Leidenfrost point it floats as a star and beats at the key, stepping down its lobes as it evaporates.

machines.name: Ghost
machines.description: Apparitions between the ears: tuned resonators split harmonics, beat and circle round the listener's head.

machines.name: Recur
machines.description: A window of the sample laid out as a square and scrambled by Arnold's cat map, until it returns exactly.

machines.name: Halcyon
machines.description: Halcyon: soft, near-pure ambient tones that swell, drift and shimmer

machines.name: Wander
machines.description: Wander: hold a key and ten of Colors In Space's key sounds wander in a scale of their own.

machines.name: Halcyon Keys
machines.description: Halcyon Keys: Halcyon's soft tones played in a scale. The white keys are the scale, so no key is ever out of it.

machines.name: Halcyon Wander
machines.description: Halcyon Wander: hold a key and Halcyon's soft tones wander in a scale of their own, after Mutable Instruments' Marbles.

machines.name: Acid Rain
machines.description: Highly optimized Open303 port: auto accent, gate, slide and octave jump, off or p-locked. pH and dew drive the sound and the rain lane. Melt your face off :)
